authority: Owner-authorized reusable local human-review workflow under ADR D052
identity_bootstrap: Explicit local OS-operator enrollment with owner-supplied ID and display name, encrypted Ed25519 key and signed proof of possession; not external legal-identity certification
authentication: Passphrase plus possession of enrolled encrypted private key on every decision
confirmation: Exact decision, question ID and full review-package manifest SHA-256; never cached or defaulted
assessment_import: Verify signature and active registration before supplying hash and allowlist to existing HumanReview importer
acceptance: Existing post-generation-validation-2.0, including fresh live M8 source validation; an approval cannot override deterministic failures
revocation: Revoked or superseded credentials cannot qualify current acceptance; original signed records remain historical
duplicate_policy: One decision per exact response/evidence/draft/policy target; revised assessments require new confirmation
